insertion_dv_ms.source: Lunar Prospector insertion into a 100 km circular lunar orbit, 898.5 m/s, quoted in D. Folta, 'Lunar Reconnaissance Observer DV Budget Estimate', NASA GSFC Code 595, 2 April 2004. Excludes stationkeeping and launch-error correction. A different spacecraft and a minimum-energy transfer, so treat as representative, not exact.

period_s.source: Calculated by js/sim/orbital.js from data/constants.json: two-body orbit, cylindrical Moon shadow, Sun in the orbit plane (beta = 0), worst orientation. Conservative; cross-check with GMAT.

eclipse_fraction.source: Calculated by js/sim/orbital.js from data/constants.json: two-body orbit, cylindrical Moon shadow, Sun in the orbit plane (beta = 0), worst orientation. Conservative; cross-check with GMAT.

eclipse_by_beta.source: Calculated by js/sim/orbital.js: eclipse share for Sun-to-orbit-plane angle beta = 0 to 90 deg in 5 deg steps. Assumes a polar orbit fixed in space, apsides over the poles, Moon axis perpendicular to the ecliptic. Cross-check with GMAT.
